content: By constant reflection on the great declaration 'Tat Tvam Asi' (That Thou Art), the illusion of separation dissolves forever.
author: Adi Shankara
explanation:
In the uncompromising architecture of Advaita Vedanta, Adi Shankara reveals that non-dual consciousness is the eternal reality behind all fleeting phenomena.

This teaching (By constant reflection on the great declaration 'Tat Tvam As...) focuses directly on constant and reflection. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on constant today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper constant and reflection in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
